$comment: Run `node "${CLAUDE_SKILL_DIR}/scripts/init-config.js"` to generate this from your own repo instead of editing by hand.

app.command: npm run build && npm run lint && npm test

tooling.description: the repo's own scripts, CI config and agent instructions

e2e.$comment: unmapped defaults to "all". Set "none" only with a real safety net, because it means a path nothing maps runs no e2e at all before merging.

mainBranchSafetyNet.description: The full Playwright suite runs hourly against main, and only a commit that passes it is promoted to staging.

review.$comment: Your standards go here, not in SKILL.md. Both reviewers read these first.
securitySurfaces: Any change to PUBLIC_ROUTES in src/middleware/routes.ts: who can now reach what?
Any raw SQL outside src/db/queries: we require the query builder everywhere else.

secondOpinion.$comment: A real second model. Without this, one model runs both passes and the report says so.

exercise.$comment: How an agent drives the running app. Without this, the live-run step is guesswork.
notes: Dev server: npm run dev, then http://localhost:3000.
Sign in with the seeded account dev@example.com / password from .env.local.
API routes accept a session cookie, so fetch from an already-signed-in page rather than minting a token.

areas.name: src/components
areas.note: covered by the e2e suite rather than by unit tests
